title: Inventory what is genuinely Threat Intelligence
description:
Find in web/hooks.py (220 lines), web/pictograms.py, publication/redesign, publication/pictograms and the content types AI, AWS, Azure, Gaming, Mission and Newsroom what is TI identity (names, editorial focus, brand, pictogram art) and what is generic layout that core already gives. Record the live URL shapes and SEO elements that must not break (sitemap, canonical, feeds, JSON-LD, aliases, /posts and /articles redirects, /settings, /icon.png).
Scenario: Every TI hook is classified
  Given web/hooks.py and web/pictograms.py
  Then each function is marked TI-specific, generic-in-core, or to be dropped, with the Papyrus issue that takes it

Depends on: PPY-bcfd2d (URL parity method).
